claim: Batching the packed seed store's durability syncs to one fsync per segment (default SyncPolicy::Batch) collapses the bind-mount ingest-write term, is crash-consistent (prefix recovery, no partial node), preserves byte-exact materialization, and lets observe-batch serve the packed store; the VOLE/SQLite contract build ratio moves from 7.08x to 0.82x on the same 12-document subset.

policy_probe_worst_doc.note: single-shot reps on the contention-prone bind mount; min is the reliable statistic, matching the court's best-of-3

contract_court.court_static_prose_note: tools/fixtures/phase18-contract-packed.py hard-codes the pre-18.5 conclusions ('observe-batch has no --packed', 'term unchanged'); its raw tables (copied under raw/court/) carry the new numbers. The fixture and court scripts were NOT modified.

crash_consistency.guarantee: Recovered open-segment records are exactly a prefix of the appended sequence: framing scan stops at the first absent/zero/oversized/overlong prefix, the torn tail is discarded (truncated on a read-write reopen), and every fetched node is re-hashed against its id. No partial node is observable.
crash_consistency.batched_default_risk: With SyncPolicy::Batch, records appended since the last seal/flush (or segment roll) may be lost on power loss. Ordering is preserved: FieldStore::put_field flushes the packed segment before a manifest is published, so a durable manifest never references non-durable nodes.
crash_consistency.policy_option: --sync=batch (default) | --sync=each (per-record fdatasync, pre-18.5 behavior). Store-level: SyncPolicy / PackedSeedStore::open_write_with_policy / FieldStore::open_packed_with_policy.

residual_risks: Batch durability is bounded by seal/flush: a crash before the final seal can lose acknowledged nodes not yet flushed, but only a suffix; the manifest ordering keeps any published field consistent.

The contract court fixture's static conclusion prose is stale (it still prints 'observe-batch has no --packed' and the falsified 18.4 conclusion); the raw tables are authoritative. The fixture was not modified per constraints.
The bind-mounted store is contention-prone; single-shot walls vary up to ~2x. All build figures are best-of-3 minimums, and the before/after mechanism probes are single-shot.
The packed warm RSS is not measured (the court runs /usr/bin/time only on the fs-direct warm lane); warm-latency ratio is the reported metric.
